args.body:
Hi Dora,

I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I think it's great that you have a personal website to showcase who you are! Having a dedicated online presence is a wonderful way to express yourself and connect with others.

A few suggestions for improvement:
- Consider adding more sections to your website, such as an "About Me" page, a portfolio, or a blog to give visitors a deeper sense of who you are and what you do.
- Including some visuals or a clean design layout could make the site more engaging and visually appealing.
- It might be worth adding links to your social media profiles or contact forms so visitors can easily reach out to you.

Overall, a solid start — keep building on it!

Best,
Emma

Hi Eve,

I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that you have a blog to share your thoughts and interests — and it's awesome that hiking is your favorite hobby! That's a fantastic topic to build content around.

A few suggestions for improvement:
- Consider adding blog posts about your hiking adventures — trail reviews, photos, tips, and gear recommendations would make for compelling content.
- A clean, nature-inspired design theme could really complement the hiking focus of your blog.
- Adding categories or tags for different hiking topics would help visitors navigate your content more easily.
- Including a comment section or newsletter signup could help you build a community of fellow hiking enthusiasts.

Looking forward to seeing your blog grow. Keep up the great work!

Best,
Emma
